1.name: Rage
1.description: Bonus Action: enter Rage without Heavy armor. Strength attacks gain the Rage damage bonus; Strength checks and saves gain Advantage; Bludgeoning, Piercing and Slashing damage is resisted. Rage prevents spellcasting and Concentration. Attacking an enemy or spending a Bonus Action to extend it maintains Rage through your next turn, up to ten minutes total. Extending an active Rage spends no additional Rage use.

1.name: Unarmored Defense
1.description: While you are not wearing any armor, your Armor Class equals 10 + your Dexterity modifier + your Constitution modifier. You can use a shield and still gain this benefit.

1.name: Weapon Mastery
1.description: Your training with weapons allows you to use the weapon mastery properties properties of two kinds of {@filter Simple=simple weapon;melee weapon=sand} or {@filter Martial Melee weapons=martial weapon;melee weapon=sand} of your choice, such as Greataxe and Handaxe. 2.name: Danger Sense
2.description: You have Advantage on Dexterity saving throws unless you are Incapacitated.

2.name: Reckless Attack
2.description: On your first attack roll of the turn, choose Reckless Attack. Strength attacks gain Advantage until your next turn starts, and attacks against you gain Advantage for the same duration.

3.name: Primal Knowledge
3.description: At level 3, choose one additional Barbarian skill proficiency. While Raging, Primal Knowledge lets you use Strength for Acrobatics, Intimidation, Perception, Stealth and Survival checks.

3.name: Primal Path
3.description: At 3rd level, you choose a path that shapes the nature of your rage from the list of available paths. Your choice grants you features at 3rd level and again at 6th, 10th, and 14th levels.

3.name: Barbarian Subclass
3.description: You gain a Barbarian subclass of your choice. A subclass is a specialization that grants you features at certain Barbarian levels. For the rest of your career, you gain each of your subclass's features that are of your Barbarian level or lower.

4.name: Ability Score Improvement
4.description: When you reach 4th level, you can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature. If your DM allows the use of feats, you may instead take a {@5etools feat.html}.

5.name: Extra Attack
5.description: Beginning at 5th level, you can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the {@action Attack} action on your turn.

5.name: Fast Movement
5.description: Starting at 5th level, your speed increases by 10 feet while you aren't wearing heavy armor.

9.name: Brutal Strike
9.description: When you use Reckless Attack, forgo Advantage on one Strength-based attack roll without Disadvantage. On a hit, deal an extra 1d10 damage and choose Forceful Blow or Hamstring Blow.

11.name: Relentless Rage
11.description: If you drop to 0 Hit Points while Raging without dying outright, you can make a DC 10 Constitution saving throw. On a success, your Hit Points become twice your Barbarian level. Each use after the first increases the DC by 5; the DC resets when you finish a Short or Long Rest.

13.name: Improved Brutal Strike
13.description: Brutal Strike can also apply Staggering Blow or Sundering Blow.

15.name: Persistent Rage
15.description: When you roll Initiative, you can regain all expended uses of Rage once per Long Rest. Your Rage lasts 10 minutes without needing to be extended and ends early if you are Unconscious or don Heavy armor.

17.name: Improved Brutal Strike
17.description: Brutal Strike deals 2d10 extra damage and can apply two different Brutal Strike effects.

7.name: Feral Instinct
7.description: You have Advantage on Initiative rolls.

7.name: Instinctive Pounce
7.description: When you use your Bonus Action to enter your Rage, you can move up to half your Speed.

20.name: Primal Champion
20.description: Your Strength and Constitution each increase by 4, to a maximum of 25.

18.name: Indomitable Might
18.description: If your total for a Strength check or Strength saving throw is less than your Strength score, you can use that score in place of the total.

19.name: Epic Boon
19.description: Choose an Epic Boon on the Character Sheet. The supported options increase one ability score by 1, to a maximum of 30.
